change.description: Add the durable assistant worker, atomic turn submission, lease and terminal-state protection, authorized metered retrieval, citations, and authenticated public chat HTTP/SSE endpoints.
change.release_unit_description: static frontend and full-feature Docker image

planned.reasoning: The additive citation table and public chat routes preserve existing storage and search contracts while introducing the approved assistant runtime boundary.

evidence.command: Locks private ownership, retrieval authorization, retention, generation lifecycle, citations, and quota behavior
Requires public retrieval to use published-only content and administrator retrieval to use the frontend principal
Requires durable generation independent of browser connection lifecycle and explicit stop

current.reasoning: The candidate adds forward-only citation and lookup-index migrations, a single SQLite worker with leases and restart-failure recovery, transactionally idempotent first-turn creation, authorization-scoped retrieval metering with unique stage keys, bounded provider execution, and owner-checked chat/snapshot/message/event/stop/delete routes. Late deltas and terminal conversations are rejected, provider SSE requires an explicit completion marker, conversation history is bounded, and unknown in-flight provider calls are not retried automatically.

evidence.command: Owns atomic submission, sequence allocation, one-active-generation conflict checks, lease transitions, late-body rejection, citation persistence, expiry, and deletion
Runs the durable worker, renews leases, persists streamed deltas, uses authorized metered retrieval, and avoids automatic retry after restart
Maps authenticated owner-scoped chat operations to 202/401/404/410/409/429 contracts and SSE snapshots
Propagates the assistant authorization and usage context through embedding, rewrite, semantic Playbook, and judgement calls

scope_drift.description: The candidate stays within T4 assistant runtime, retrieval, public API, and citation persistence surfaces; admin UI, public UI, clipping cutover, production migration, and deployment remain out of scope.

verified.reasoning: Focused storage, worker, retrieval-context, and HTTP/SSE tests pass, including provider failure, restart recovery, owner isolation, and legacy migration coverage. The repository check passes with the existing Biome warnings and infos. Migration journal validation, changed-file formatting, diff checks, and changed-surface TypeScript filtering were run; the remaining filtered diagnostics are pre-existing in unrelated routes/tests.
